name: fraudguard
description: Multi-Account Abuse Detection & Fraudulent Signup Prevention System

scripts.test: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const fs=require('fs'); const candidates=[process.platform==='win32'?'backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe':'backend/.venv/bin/python', process.platform==='win32'?'.venv/Scripts/python.exe':'.venv/bin/python']; const py=candidates.find(p=>fs.existsSync(p))||(process.platform==='win32'?'python':'python3'); const res=spawnSync(py, ['-m', 'pytest', 'backend/tests', '-v'], {stdio:'inherit'}); process.exit(res.status??1);"
